title: ULTIMATE AUTH
description: UltimateAuth is a powerful, modern authentication system for offline-mode Minecraft servers. Packed with security features, full spawn control, IP-based registration limits, movement lockdown, blindness effects, and a polished user experience.
body:
# UltimateAuth

**UltimateAuth is a secure, performance‑first authentication plugin for offline‑mode servers (Spigot, Bukkit, Paper, Purpur 1.21+). It delivers a clean login/register experience while completely locking down unauthenticated players to prevent impersonation, grief, and unauthorized access.**

**Whether you run a small SMP or a large network, UltimateAuth ensures every player verifies before they can move, interact, or play — and everything is fully configurable with full Hex and Legacy Color support.**

## Features

### ✔ Full Authentication Lockdown
Unauthenticated players cannot:
- Move or rotate their aim
- Use commands (except `/register`, `/login`)
- Break or place blocks
- Interact with the world or drop/pickup items
- Chat

**Optional protections:**
- Auth timeout with automatic kick
- Persistent Title and Action bar prompts during auth

### ✔ Advanced Ban System
UltimateAuth includes a built-in moderation system specifically designed to handle rule-breakers efficiently:
- Issue permanent bans with custom reasons.
- Issue temporary bans with exact durations (days, months, years).
- Easily revoke bans.

### ✔ Security & Anti‑Abuse Tools
- **IP‑Based Registration Limits:** Prevent players from registering too many accounts from a single IP.
- **Join Rate Limiting:** Built-in join throttling to prevent bot attacks.
- **Brute‑Force Protection:** Limits maximum failed login/register attempts before kicking the user to prevent password guessing.
- **BCrypt Hashing:** All passwords are securely hashed using jBcrypt.

### ✔ Fully Configurable
Every major feature, string, and layout can be toggled and tuned:
- `config.yml` - Configure timeouts, IP limits, and database settings (SQLite supported).
- `messages.yml` - Customize every single message, title, and kick screen using either modern **MiniMessage formatting** (e.g., `<red>`, `<gradient>`) or **Legacy/Hex Color Codes** (e.g., `&a`, `&#00fbff`).

---

## Commands & Permissions

### Player Commands
| Command | Description | Permission |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/register <password> <password>` | Register a new authentication account. | None |
| `/login <password>` | Login to your authentication account. | None |
| `/changepassword <old> <new>` | Change your authentication password. | `ultimateauth.auth.use` |
| `/logout` | Logout from your current session. | `ultimateauth.auth.use` |

### Admin Commands
| Command | Description | Permission |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/auth reload` | Reload the plugin configuration files. | `ultimateauth.auth.admin` |
| `/auth reset <player>` | Reset a player's session. | `ultimateauth.auth.admin` |
| `/auth unregister <player>` | Unregister a player's account. | `ultimateauth.auth.admin` |
| `/tempban <reason> <player> <days>` | Temporarily ban a player. | `ultimateauth.ban.admin` |
| `/permanentban <reason> <player>` | Permanently ban a player. | `ultimateauth.ban.admin` |
| `/unban <player>` | Remove an active ban from a player. | `ultimateauth.ban.admin` |
